ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti, including the actions of federal agents and the handling of evidence.
ideas.angle: Examining the use of force by federal agents and the need for transparency in their actions
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Was the use of force by federal agents justified?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the need for accountability and transparency in law enforcement actions.
